name: Scholarship on Merit Basis
benefit: Under this scheme, one student from each undergraduate and postgraduate class at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University is awarded a scholarship equal to the tuition fee of their respective class.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be enrolled in an undergraduate or postgraduate course at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University. 1. The student must have secured the highest marks in the relevant course, class, or subject.
